description:
Returns observations with 1991–2020 baseline comparisons at daily, weekly, or monthly granularity for a location and period.
When to use: Graph or tabulate recent anomalies at a location for a specific period — e.g. 'how did last month compare to normal?'
Date format: YYYYMMDD for ymd; use groupby (day/week/month) to control granularity. For 'last week' use YYYYMMDD of 7 days ago. For 'last month' use YYYYMM of prior month.
Performance: Computed on demand; moderate speed.
Prerequisites: Use /location to obtain a locid first.
Investigate: Use after /anomalies or /breaking. Identifies a city of interest; provides per-day/week detail for drill-down. Combine groupby=DAY/FULL_DAY with a recent date range for 'recent days with departure from normal' queries.
Augment: Provides the per-period anomaly series for prose ('temperatures were above normal for 12 of the past 14 days'). Returns: loc, ts, vals, N, vals_ts, baseline.
